description: This file defines decorators for property coercion in Angular, including coercion to boolean, number, CSS pixel value, array, and string array, utilizing Angular CDK coercion functions.

methods.name: coerceBoolean
methods.description: Decorator factory that creates a property decorator to coerce a property to boolean.

methods.name: coerceNumber
methods.description: Decorator factory that creates a property decorator to coerce a property to number.

methods.name: coerceCssPixelValue
methods.description: Decorator factory that creates a property decorator to coerce a property to CSS pixel value.

methods.name: coerceArray
methods.description: Decorator factory that creates a property decorator to coerce a property to an array.

methods.name: coerceStringArray
methods.description: Decorator factory that creates a property decorator to coerce a property to a string array with optional separator.
